tagline: Leading global hearing healthcare company improving millions of lives
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator reflecting the position of global market leader in the hearing aid sector, with stable growth of 3.7% despite a mature market, supported by product innovation and geographic expansion.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of hearing aids and associated services.
kpis.description: Revenue advances to reach 22.4 billion DKK in 2024, supported by product innovation and geographic expansion.
kpis.signal: Stable growth despite a mature market.

kpis.name: Operating income before special items
kpis.explanation: Operating profit without exceptional charges or gains.
kpis.description: Operating income before special items reaches 4.4 billion DKK, reflecting strong cost discipline.
kpis.signal: High operating margin for an industrial model.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains elevated at around 70.5%, thanks to the perceived value of premium products.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin typical of innovative medical devices.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin stands at 19.7% in 2024 (4.4 bn / 22.4 bn), slightly down from a peak in 2022.
kpis.signal: Solid operating margin despite increasing investments.

kpis.name: R&D spending
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D spending represents 8.1% of revenue in 2024, steadily increasing since 2021, reflecting commitment to product innovation.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in product innovation and technological capabilities.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to acquire or improve physical assets and infrastructure.
kpis.description: Investments reach 1.2 billion DKK in 2024, supported by automation and infrastructure modernization projects.
kpis.signal: CAPEX increasing to modernize factories and logistics.

kpis.name: Lives improved
kpis.explanation: Cumulative number of people who have benefited from a Demant hearing aid in the customer base.
kpis.description: 10.9 million lives improved in 2024, up 600,000 from 2023. Demant continues on its trajectory toward the 2030 target of 16+ million lives improved.
kpis.signal: Key social impact indicator, growing steadily and aligned with the 2030 target.

kpis.name: Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions
kpis.explanation: Direct and indirect greenhouse gas emissions (scopes 1 and 2).
kpis.description: Emissions decline to 29,426 tonnes CO2e in 2024, down 11.7% year-over-year. Demant progresses toward its 2030 target of 46% reduction vs. 2019 baseline.
kpis.signal: Significant emissions reduction through energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of hearing aids and associated services.
kpis.description: Revenue advances to reach 22.4 billion DKK in 2024, supported by product innovation and geographic expansion.
kpis.signal: Stable growth despite a mature market.

kpis.name: Lives improved
kpis.explanation: Cumulative number of people who have benefited from a Demant hearing aid.
kpis.description: 10.9 million lives improved in 2024, up 600,000 from 2023. Progress toward the 2030 target of 16+ million.
kpis.signal: Key social impact indicator, growing steadily toward the 2030 target.

risks.title: Dependence on specialized suppliers and supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in Item 1A with moderate but repeated language: supply disruptions, dependency on key suppliers. Central position in the Supply chain risks section. Stable trend but structural. High weight: production in Poland and Mexico, dependence on highly specialized suppliers.

risks.title: Regulatory risks related to reimbursement schemes and public tenders
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified in Regulatory risks in the markets. Moderate language: stable regulatory landscape currently, but acknowledgment that overlap with commercial risks if reimbursement levels change. Important position in Item 1A. Stable trend for now but structural industry risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and protection of customer personal data
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section on Data and IT security with moderate to high intensity language: broader interface, data breaches, serious consequences. Explicit acknowledgment of increasing complexity with digitalization. ISO 27001 certification obtained. Trend up: audit committee will take responsibility from 2025.

risks.title: Intense competition and consolidation of the hearing aid market
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly described as extremely competitive market in Market and customer risks. Moderate to high intensity language on consolidation: fewer players, lower fitting fees, lost customer loyalty. Specific risk from OTC category in the US since 2022. Stable trend but active monitoring required.

risks.title: Intellectual property and protection of technology patents
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Innovation risks: protect and maintain patents and ensuring that we do not infringe the rights of others. Moderate language but explicit acknowledgment of counterfeiting risk. Position in innovation section. Stable trend. Moderate weight: vital to maintain competitive advantage but no details on current litigation.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance on import/export and sanctions-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Two sub-risks: (1) Regulations regarding import and export with potential cost impact; (2) Sanction-related risks explicitly mentioned: EU/US sanctions, Russia/Belarus. Moderate language. Trend up: increasing geopolitics: Ukraine, trade tensions. Moderate weight but increasing.

risks.title: Attraction and retention of key talent in R&D and innovation
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Innovation risks: must continue to attract the most competent employees in key areas. Moderate language but explicit acknowledgment of importance. Mitigation through corporate culture, training, and engagement. Stable trend. Moderate weight: critical to maintain innovative advantage.

risks.title: Macroeconomic impacts and demand for hearing solution services
risks.score_rationale: Section on Macroeconomic impacts on markets acknowledges current uncertainties affecting certain regions and high inflation. Moderate language: may have an adverse effect. Market historically stable but vulnerable to shocks. Trend up: current macroeconomic uncertainties. Moderate weight: demand is non-cyclical but sensitive to income.

ai_positioning.summary: Demant progressively integrates artificial intelligence into its hearing aids to improve user experience, notably through automatic adaptation features to sound environments. AI is used as a product innovation lever, but not as a central transformation driver.
evidence: AI integration in new hearing aid models for noise filtering
Machine learning capabilities to personalize sound settings
Technology partnerships to strengthen software capabilities
